name: chauffeur
description: A driver for hours or days, in the driver's car or the buyer's.

languages.description: Languages it is offered in, as BCP 47 tags such as en or es.

ownCar.description: True when the driver brings the car. False or absent: the buyer's car.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking and releases at the end of it. Done is the driver there on time for the whole booking. A timer to the seller, set past the booking, pays for driving done if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, check whose car it is and who pays for fuel.
